trade_thesis: Gold (XAUUSD) has experienced an extreme +120-dollar intraday parabolic expansion from 3453.8 to 3575.4. While the macro trend is intensely bullish aided by DXY softness at 103.61, the 15-minute volume has precipitously dropped from 9,882 contracts to merely 792 on the latest test of the 3575.4 high as New York session liquidity dries up past 18:50 UTC. Chasing long at the absolute intraday peak with decelerating volume creates severe asymmetric drawdown risk for a $62 account, while shorting against this runaway momentum lacks a confirmed lower-high structural breakdown. Prudence dictates waiting for an orderly pullback towards the 3550-3555 liquidity shelf or a clear volume-backed breakout above 3576 before deploying capital.
